summary: Listed as a Mitchell County tower on a statewide NC list (35.85, -82.09916). No North Carolina lookout on this mountain was found in any source read.

evidence.supports: statewide list entry: Grassy Mountain, Mitchell County, 35.85, -82.09916

notes_for_editor: Only one source: the statewide list entry, which gives no builder, date, height or status. Two web searches (Mitchell County, Spruce Pine, NC Forest Service) returned no North Carolina lookout on a Grassy Mountain in Mitchell County. Results were other places of that name: a standing 1938 fire tower on Grassy Mountain in Murray County, Georgia (already in our records as us-ga-grassy-mountain), a Rutherford County summit near Sugar Hill, and an Oregon lookout. The Georgia tower is a likely source of confusion, but nothing ties this entry to it. The story is far below the 120-word floor. Recommend holding it from publication until a Mitchell County or NC Forest Service record confirms a tower. Check the coordinates on a map before use. No photos added.
